title: How Do You Know You Are Awake?
summary: A translation of the same day's philosophy episode, debating whether it is possible to be certain that the waking world is real; it compares Descartes's dream and evil-demon arguments, al-Ghazālī's months-long crisis of certainty in al-Munqidh, Zhuangzi's butterfly dream, and Ibn Sīnā's floating man who knows nothing but his own existence.
